description: This file defines a factory class for creating instances of IGrainDirectoryCache with different caching strategies, along with a null implementation of IGrainDirectoryCache used as a fallback or default. It includes methods for creating caches based on configuration options and services, and a simple cache class that performs no caching.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryCacheFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating IGrainDirectoryCache instances based on provided options and dependency injection.

classes.name: NullGrainDirectoryCache
classes.description: A simple implementation of IGrainDirectoryCache that performs no caching (null object pattern).

methods.name: CreateGrainDirectoryCache
methods.description: Creates an IGrainDirectoryCache instance based on options, selecting different caching strategies or defaulting to services.

methods.name: CreateCustomGrainDirectoryCache
methods.description: Creates a custom cache by attempting to retrieve it from services, or fallback to a default cache.
